name: ruchs-storefront
description: Ruchs storefront on Cloudflare Workers with Shopify checkout and virtual try-on

scripts.build: python scripts/remap.py && node scripts/build_showcase.mjs && esbuild scripts/decart-live-source.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --outfile=dist/decart-live.js && python scripts/build_worker.py
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
scripts.sync:deploy: npm run sync && npm run deploy:cloudflare
scripts.test: node --no-warnings tests/shopify-worker.mjs && node --no-warnings tests/tryon-worker.mjs && node --no-warnings tests/live-worker.mjs && node --no-warnings tests/forms-worker.mjs
